originality: Original E2A 5v5 possession built from the owner's keyframes. Not a reconstruction of any NBA, EuroLeague or FIBA possession. Coaching principles only (no copied diagrams, footage or graphics): screener as the release valve against two on the ball, 4-on-3 behind the trap, weak-side help and the 45-degree cut behind the helper.
principle_sources: Tipton, MPnR: the screener as the 'silent assassin' when the ball is blitzed (principle only)
Hooper University: 45 cuts behind help (principle only)
The Hoops Geek: pick and roll vs blitz / 4-on-3 reads (principle only)
FIBA WABC Coaching Manual Level 3: help-side rotation and reading the helper (principle only)
FIBA Official Basketball Rules 2026: court dimensions (geometry only)

coordinates.engine_mapping: engine x = -owner x (engine x < 0 = the offence's right = screen right with the basket at the top), engine y = owner y, engine t = owner t + engine_offset_s

players.role: Ball handler (right slot). Uses the ball screen, gets two on the ball, outlets early to the screener.
Weak-side (left) wing. 45-degree cut behind X4. Answer C (CUT, correct).
Screener. Short roll to the nail, catches the outlet, decides (4 on 3). Answer A (DRIVE) is his.
On the ball. Traps with X5.
Weak-side corner. Stays home (the corner pass is contested).
Weak-side wing / the rotating helper. Tags the roller, steps into the paint to stop O5, loses O4.
Screener's defender. Leaves O5 to blitz the ball with X1; recovers late.
